effect.kubejs.vulnerable.description: Take additional magic damage per hit based on effect level.
effect.kubejs.golem.desc: Automatically summons an Iron Golem to assist when health drops below a certain point.
effect.kubejs.antitoxic.description: Grants immunity to some negative effects without affecting other statuses. Can only be removed when taking damage.
effect.kubejs.radiation.description: Sustains radiation damage over time. Requires Mekanism mod.
effect.kubejs.anti_radiation.description: Grants immunity to radiation damage. Requires Mekanism mod.
effect.kubejs.burning.description: Remains burning, taking fire damage, and re-ignites when leaving water.

effect.kubejs.health_lose.description: Lose additional health per hit, more effective at higher health. Ineffective against boss mobs.
effect.kubejs.bombegranate_support.descr: Applies blasting effect to attackers when health drops low, detonating after 10 seconds.
enchantment.kubejs.damage_bonus.desc: +1.5 base damage per level. Extra bonus against undead, sculk mobs, Ender Dragon, and QuantumSuit wearers.
enchantment.kubejs.health_theft.desc: Grants Regeneration and drains attacker's health on damage. Conflicts with Thorns.
enchantment.kubejs.toxic.desc: Attacks inflict Poison but consume extra durability.
enchantment.kubejs.rapid_cooldown.desc: Increases Haste level after attack and reduces attack cooldown.
enchantment.kubejs.blood_thirsty.desc: Attacks grant Regeneration but consume extra durability.
enchantment.kubejs.duel.desc: Attacks grant Strength but inflict Hunger and Vulnerability.
enchantment.kubejs.health_lose.desc: Applies Health Drain effect. Ineffective against bosses. High durability cost.
enchantment.kubejs.void_rescue.desc: Teleports to safety when falling into the void, destroying a piece of armor.
